name: DEMO-16
description: A demo machine built from TURBO-16: a blitter beside the rasterizer, a frame clock, 64K of memory and an instruction made for the scroller. Copper bars, a starfield, a sine scroller and a shaded icosahedron, each on a steady beat at 1 MHz, and then all of them at once.
readme:
# DEMO-16

What can a 16 bit machine show at one megahertz? DEMO-16 is [TURBO-16](exuarch:package/TURBO-16) with a few parts added in the hardware and microcode editors, the way anyone could:

- a [blitter](exuarch:device/blit) that fills rectangles on the same screen as the [rasterizer](exuarch:device/rast), with instructions to drive it (`BX`, `BY`, `BW`, `BH`, `BC` and their immediate forms, [BGO](exuarch:instruction/BGO) and [BST](exuarch:instruction/BST));
- a [frame clock](exuarch:device/rtc) and [BEATS](exuarch:device/pic), so a program shows each frame on a steady beat in real time ([TIMI](exuarch:instruction/TIMI), [TST](exuarch:instruction/TST), [TACK](exuarch:instruction/TACK));
- [MEMORY](exuarch:device/mem) grown from 4K to the whole 64K, for tables worked out in advance;
- [BYGO](exuarch:instruction/BYGO), an instruction made for the scroller: it waits for the blitter, gives it a row and starts it, so one dot of a letter is one instruction.

Five programs: four effects, and then all four at once. Set the clock to **1 MHz** (the right end of the slider) or run at **⚡ Max**. The beat is real time, so at a slower clock a frame misses its beat and the picture slows down; at a faster one it keeps to the beat.

| Program | Ticks a frame takes | Beat | Frames a second at 1 MHz |
|---|---|---|---|
| [The whole demo](<exuarch:program/The whole demo>) | 77,070 at most | 80 ms | 12.5 |
| [Copper bars](<exuarch:program/Copper bars>) | 58,115 at most | 60 ms | 16.7 |
| [Starfield](exuarch:program/Starfield) | 36,217 at most | 40 ms | 25 |
| [Sine scroller](<exuarch:program/Sine scroller>) | 26,039 at most | 33 ms | 30 |
| [A shaded icosahedron](<exuarch:program/A shaded icosahedron>) | 33,678 at most | 40 ms | 25 |

## The budget

The screen is 640 by 480, 307,200 pixels, and whatever draws on it, the rasterizer or the blitter, fills one pixel a tick. Clearing the whole screen ([CLS](exuarch:instruction/CLS)) and showing a finished frame ([SWAP](exuarch:instruction/SWAP)) are one tick each. So redrawing every pixel would take a third of a second, and a frame at 25 a second has 40,000 ticks: room for an eighth of the screen. Each effect keeps the background black, which is free, and draws only what moves.

The rasterizer and the blitter work on their own while the CPU runs on, so the programs give the CPU the next frame's sums while a frame is drawn. They share one video bus, though, so they must never draw at the same time: two devices driving one bus is an error. [GST](exuarch:instruction/GST) and [BST](exuarch:instruction/BST) say when each is done.

## The effects

**Copper bars.** Each bar goes round a circle seen edge on, so it rides up and down the screen. It is four bands of two triangles each, right across the screen, and the rasterizer blends the corner colours: dark edge, colour, a near white shine in the middle, colour, dark edge. The bars on the far side of the circle are drawn first, dimmer, so the near ones pass in front of them. Six bars 14 pixels thick are 53,760 pixels, so this one is all fill: the rasterizer is busy 95% of the time.

**Starfield.** Each star has an x and a y across the sky and a distance z that shrinks every frame. It is drawn at `320 + x * 64 / z`, with the [multiply-accumulate unit](exuarch:device/mac) doing the division ([MDIV](exuarch:instruction/MDIV)). One compare finds a star off either edge, because a negative coordinate is a large unsigned number. A star that comes too close or leaves the screen starts again far away. The blitter is idle 98% of the time: a star is at most 9 pixels, and it is the CPU's 220 ticks of sums per star that set the pace.

**Sine scroller.** The font is 5 by 7 dots, one cell per column of a letter with a bit for each dot. Each dot is a 6 by 6 blitter square. The CPU sets the blitter's column and colour once per column, then tests the seven bits one after another, with no loop, and sends each dot that is there with `BYGO`. The wave's height for each of its 128 half steps is worked out once, at the start, into a table.

**A shaded icosahedron.** Every frame the CPU turns the twelve corners about two axes with the multiply-accumulate unit, and shades each corner by how much it faces the viewer: one of 16 steps of its face's colour, the brightest going towards white. It keeps only the faces whose corners go round the screen the right way, with the cross product in [xp](exuarch:device/xp), as TURBO-16 does. As the icosahedron is convex, the faces it keeps never cover each other, so there is no depth buffer and every pixel takes one tick.

**The whole demo.** First it works out the icosahedron for all 128 frames of its tumble, which then repeats, while a bar grows across the screen: about two seconds at 1 MHz. After that, each frame:

1. The blitter draws the stars, worked out during the frame before.
2. The rasterizer draws one triangle list: five bars on the far side of their circle, the icosahedron, the bars on the near side, so the chain of bars goes round it. The icosahedron's triangles are only copied in, with [COPYT](exuarch:instruction/COPYT).
3. Meanwhile the CPU works out the next frame's stars and bars, and where every column of this frame's scroller goes.
4. When the rasterizer is done, the blitter draws the scroller from those columns, as fast as `BYGO` can feed it.

Every part of the CPU's work fits into the time the rasterizer or the blitter is drawing, so neither of them waits for long.

## Things to try

1. Run each program with the **Trace** shut and watch the clock graph: it sits at 1 MHz, and the frames come on the beat.
2. In [Copper bars](<exuarch:program/Copper bars>), change `TIMI 60` to `TIMI 40`. The bars need 58,115 ticks, more than the 40 ms beat holds at 1 MHz, so frames miss beats and the motion stutters.
3. In [Starfield](exuarch:program/Starfield), change `SUBI 3` to `SUBI 8`: warp speed, as every star comes nearer more than twice as fast.
4. In [A shaded icosahedron](<exuarch:program/A shaded icosahedron>), change the `JMI fnext` in `build` to `JPL fnext`: you see the inside of the far faces.
5. In [The whole demo](<exuarch:program/The whole demo>), move `CALL dots` to just after `GO`, so the blitter draws while the rasterizer still does. Two devices drive the video bus in the same tick, and the machine stops with an error.
6. Open **BYGO** in the [Microcode](exuarch:tab/Microcode) tab: four steps, two of them only when the blitter is idle. Tick through one in the Run view while the blitter is busy and watch it fetch itself again.
7. Change the message: it is the `msg` lines at the end of [Sine scroller](<exuarch:program/Sine scroller>), capital letters, digits and `! , - . :` only.

## Read more

- [TURBO-16](exuarch:package/TURBO-16), where the rasterizer half of this machine comes from, and [COPRO-16](exuarch:package/COPRO-16), where the blitter does.
- [The graphics pipeline](exuarch:guide/graphics-pipeline): triangles, shading and projection.
- [Bus masters and coprocessors](exuarch:guide/bus-masters): devices that draw on a bus of their own while the CPU runs on.
- [Microcode](exuarch:guide/microcode): how an instruction like `BYGO` is made of steps.

programs.name: The whole demo
programs.description: Stars, copper bars round a shaded icosahedron and a scroller, with the blitter and the rasterizer taking turns at the screen
programs.source:
; The whole demo
; Stars, copper bars round a shaded icosahedron, and a sine scroller, all at once. One video bus feeds the screen, so
; the blitter and the rasterizer take turns at it, and the CPU never waits for either if it can help it. Each frame:
; 1. the blitter draws the stars, worked out the frame before;
; 2. the rasterizer draws one list: the bars behind, the icosahedron, the bars in front;
; 3. meanwhile the CPU works out the next frame's stars and bars, and where every column of this frame's scroller goes;
; 4. then the blitter draws the scroller from those columns, a dot at a time with BYGO.
; The icosahedron turns through 128 frames and then repeats, so its triangles for every frame are worked out once, at
; the start, while a bar shows how far it has got: after that it costs the CPU nothing but a copy.
; MEMORY above the program: the stars to draw from 40000, the scroller's wave heights from 40400 and its columns from
; 40600, the bars' triangles from 41000 and 41600, the icosahedron's 128 frames from 43000 with their sizes from 61500,
; and the stack at the top.
           CALL     waves                       ; the scroller's wave heights, once
           CALL     precalc                     ; and the icosahedron's 128 frames
           CALL     plan                        ; the first frame's stars and triangles
           TIMI     80                          ; then a frame every 80 ms: about 12 a second
frame:     CALL     drawstars                   ; 1. the stars
swait:     BST
           CMPI     0
           JNE      swait
           LDI      0                           ; 2. the list: the bars behind, the icosahedron, the bars in front
           ALP
           LBA      41000
           TBA
           AMP
           LDA      nb
           CALL     copyn
           LDA      icoat
           AMP
           LDA      nico
           CALL     copyn
           LBA      41600
           TBA
           AMP
           LDA      nf
           CALL     copyn
           LDI      0
           GADR
           LDA      nb
           TAB
           LDA      nico
           ADD
           TAB
           LDA      nf
           ADD
           GCNT
           GO
           LDA      t                           ; 3. the next frame, and this one's scroller, while it is drawn
           INA
           STA      t
           CALL     plan
           CALL     prep
rwait:     GST
           CMPI     0
           JNE      rwait
           CALL     dots                        ; 4. the scroller on top
           CALL     advance
bwait:     BST
           CMPI     0
           JNE      bwait
beat:      TST
           CMPI     0
           JEQ      beat
           TACK
           SWAP
           CLS
           JMP      frame

; copyn: A triangles from MEMORY at mp into the triangle list at lp
copyn:     CMPI     0
           JEQ      cdone
           STA      count
cloop:     COPYT
           LDA      count
           SUBI     1
           STA      count
           JNE      cloop
cdone:     RET

; plan: frame t's stars into starbuf, its bars into the two triangle blocks, and where its icosahedron is
plan:      CALL     stars
           LBA      41000
           TBA
           AMP
           LDI      0
           STA      ntri
           STA      pass
           CALL     bars
           LDA      ntri
           STA      nb
           LBA      41600
           TBA
           AMP
           LDI      0
           STA      ntri
           LDI      1
           STA      pass
           CALL     bars
           LDA      ntri
           STA      nf
           CALL     icoblock
           RET

; icoblock: where the icosahedron's triangles for frame t are, worked out by precalc: icoat and nico
icoblock:  LDA      t                           ; block t mod 128, 144 cells each: room for 12 triangles
           ANDI     127
           STA      idx
           XA
           LDI      144
           XB
           XMUL
           XRD
           ADDI     43000
           STA      icoat
           LBA      61500
           LDA      idx
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA      nico
           RET

; precalc: the icosahedron turns through 128 frames and then repeats, so all of them are worked out first, with a
; bar growing across the screen to show how far it has got
precalc:   LDI      0
           STA      t
pcblock:   CALL     icoblock
           CALL     turn
           LDA      icoat
           AMP
           LDI      0
           STA      ntri
           CALL     build
           LBA      61500                       ; how many triangles it has
           LDA      idx
           ADD
           TAB
           LDA      ntri
           STX
pcwait:    BST                                  ; the bar: 4 pixels for every frame done
           CMPI     0
           JNE      pcwait
           BXI      64
           BYI      236
           BHI      8
           BCI      0x07FF
           LDA      t
           TAB
           ADD
           TAB
           ADD
           ADDI     4
           BW
           BGO
pcshow:    BST
           CMPI     0
           JNE      pcshow
           SWAP
           LDA      t
           INA
           STA      t
           CMPI     128
           JNE      pcblock
           CLS                                  ; clear both buffers
           SWAP
           CLS
           LDI      0
           STA      t
           RET

; ---- Stars ----

; stars: each star a step nearer; those on the screen go into starbuf as x, y, size and colour, nstar of them
stars:     LBA      stardata
           TBA
           STA      spt
           LBA      40000
           TBA
           AMP
           LDI      0
           STA      nstar
           LDI      60
           STA      n
star:      LDA      spt                         ; x, y and z of this star
           TAB
           LDX
           STA      vx
           INB
           LDX
           STA      vy
           INB
           LDX                                  ; nearer: z = z - 3, or far away again
           SUBI     3
           CMPI     8
           JCC      near
           LDI      255
near:      STX
           STA      z
           TBA
           STA      zp
           INB
           TBA
           STA      spt
           LDA      vx                          ; screen x = 320 + x * 64 / z
           MA
           MBI      64
           MUL
           LDA      z
           MB
           MDIV
           MRD
           ADDI     320
           CMPI     637
           JCC      gone
           STA      sx
           LDA      vy                          ; screen y = 240 + y * 64 / z
           MA
           MBI      64
           MUL
           LDA      z
           MB
           MDIV
           MRD
           ADDI     240
           CMPI     477
           JCC      gone
           STA      sy
           LDA      sx
           PUTM
           LDA      sy
           PUTM
           LDA      z                           ; the nearer, the bigger and brighter
           CMPI     85
           JCS      big
           CMPI     170
           JCS      mid
           LDI      1
           PUTM
           LDI      0x9CF3
           PUTM
           JMP      kept
mid:       LDI      2
           PUTM
           LDI      0xAD75
           PUTM
           JMP      kept
big:       LDI      3
           PUTM
           LDI      0xFFFF
           PUTM
kept:      LDA      nstar
           INA
           STA      nstar
           JMP      snext
gone:      LDA      zp                          ; off the screen: far away again
           TAB
           LDI      255
           STX
snext:     LDA      n
           SUBI     1
           STA      n
           JNE      star
           RET

; drawstars: the blitter draws the stars in starbuf; each is done before the CPU has the next one ready
drawstars: LDA      nstar
           CMPI     0
           JEQ      dsdone
           STA      n
           LBA      40000
ds:        LDX
           BX
           INB
           LDX
           BY
           INB
           LDX
           BW
           BH
           INB
           LDX
           BC
           INB
           BGO
           LDA      n
           SUBI     1
           STA      n
           JNE      ds
dsdone:    RET

; ---- Copper bars ----

; bars: the 5 bars on the far side of their circle when pass is 0, or on the near side when it is 1
bars:      LDA      t
           ANDI     63
           STA      ph
           LDI      0
           STA      i
bar:       LBA      cos_table                   ; behind when cos(ph) < 0
           LDA      ph
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           CMPI     0
           JMI      bbehind
           LDA      pass
           CMPI     1
           JNE      bnext
           JMP      bdraw
bbehind:   LDA      pass
           CMPI     0
           JNE      bnext
bdraw:     LBA      sin_table                   ; yc = 200 + sin(ph) * 120 / 256
           LDA      ph
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           MA
           MBI      120
           MUL
           MRD
           ADDI     200
           STA      yc
           SUBI     6
           STA      qy0
           LDA      pass                        ; colours: pass * 6 + i
           CMPI     0
           JEQ      colour
           LDI      5
colour:    TAB
           LDA      i
           ADD
           STA      ck
           LBA      bright
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA      cmid
           LBA      shine
           LDA      ck
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA      cshine
           LBA      dark
           LDA      ck
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA      qc0                         ; four bands down the bar: edge, colour, shine, colour, edge
           STA      cedge
           LDA      yc
           SUBI     2
           STA      qy1
           LDA      cmid
           STA      qc1
           CALL     quad
           LDA      yc
           STA      qy1
           LDA      cshine
           STA      qc1
           CALL     quad
           LDA      yc
           ADDI     2
           STA      qy1
           LDA      cmid
           STA      qc1
           CALL     quad
           LDA      yc
           ADDI     6
           STA      qy1
           LDA      cedge
           STA      qc1
           CALL     quad
           LDA      ntri
           ADDI     8
           STA      ntri
bnext:     LDA      ph                          ; the next bar, a little further round
           ADDI     7
           ANDI     63
           STA      ph
           LDA      i
           INA
           STA      i
           CMPI     5
           JNE      bar
           RET

; quad: two triangles across the screen from row qy0 in colour qc0 to row qy1 in colour qc1, into MEMORY at mp;
; then qy1 and qc1 become qy0 and qc0, for the band below
quad:      LDI      0
           PUTM
           LDA      qy0
           PUTM
           LDI      0
           PUTM
           LDA      qc0
           PUTM
           LDI      640
           PUTM
           LDA      qy0
           PUTM
           LDI      0
           PUTM
           LDA      qc0
           PUTM
           LDI      0
           PUTM
           LDA      qy1
           PUTM
           LDI      0
           PUTM
           LDA      qc1
           PUTM
           LDI      640
           PUTM
           LDA      qy0
           PUTM
           LDI      0
           PUTM
           LDA      qc0
           PUTM
           LDI      640
           PUTM
           LDA      qy1
           PUTM
           LDI      0
           PUTM
           LDA      qc1
           PUTM
           LDI      0
           PUTM
           LDA      qy1
           PUTM
           LDI      0
           PUTM
           LDA      qc1
           PUTM
           LDA      qy1                         ; the next band starts where this one ends
           STA      qy0
           LDA      qc1
           STA      qc0
           RET

; ---- The icosahedron ----

; turn: the angles for frame t, then every corner (x, y, z) in verts becomes (screen x, screen y, shade) in proj
turn:      LDA      t                           ; turning about the vertical axis: angle t
           ANDI     63
           STA      ai
           LBA      cos_table
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA      ca
           LBA      sin_table
           LDA      ai
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA      sa
           TAB
           LDI      0
           SUB
           STA      nsa
           LDA      t                           ; and about the horizontal axis, half as fast
           LSRI     1
           ANDI     63
           STA      ai
           LBA      cos_table
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA      cb
           LBA      sin_table
           LDA      ai
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA      sb
           TAB
           LDI      0
           SUB
           STA      nsb

           LBA      verts
           TBA
           STA      p
           LBA      proj
           TBA
           AMP
           LDI      12
           STA      count
corner:    LDA      p
           TAB
           LDX
           STA      vx

           MA
           LDA      ca

           MUL
           LDA      vz
           MA
           LDA      sa
           MB
           MAC
           MRD
           ADDI     320                         ; screen x
           PUTM
           LDA      vz                          ; z1 = z cos a - x sin a
           MA
           LDA      ca
           MB
           MUL
           LDA      vx
           MA
           LDA      nsa
           MB

           MRD

           LDA      cb

           LDA      z1
           MA
           LDA      nsb
           MB
           MAC
           MRD
           ADDI     200                         ; screen y
           PUTM
           LDA      vy                          ; z2 = y sin b + z1 cos b
           MA
           LDA      sb
           MB
           MUL
           LDA      z1
           MA
           LDA      cb
           MB
           MAC
           MRD
           ADDI     72                          ; shade = (z2 + 72) * 26 / 256, 0 on the far side to 15 on the near
           MA
           MBI      26
           MUL
           MRD
           PUTM
           LDA      count
           SUBI     1
           STA      count
           JNE      corner

           TAB

           INB
           LDX

           TAB
           LDX
           STA      x1
           INB

           LDX

           LDA      y2

           TAB

           PUTM
           INB
           LDX
           PUTM
           INB

           TAB

; prep: where each column of this frame's scroller goes, into MEMORY from 40600 as x, colour, dots and

           STA      sk

           STA      sj

           STA      ci

           SUB

pcol:      LDA      sj                          ; the sixth column of a letter is the gap before the next

           LDA      dx

           LDA      ph

           TAB

           LDA      ph

           LDA      sj

programs.name: Copper bars
programs.description: Six shaded bars on a turning cylinder, four rasterizer bands each
programs.source:
; Copper bars
; Six bars on a turning cylinder: each goes round a circle seen edge on, so it moves up and down the screen. A bar is
; four bands of two triangles right across the screen, which the rasterizer shades from a dark edge to the bar's
; colour, a near white shine in the middle, and back. The bars on the far side of the circle are drawn first and
; dimmer, so the near ones pass in front of them.
; While the rasterizer draws one frame, the CPU builds the next one's triangles in MEMORY; then it waits for the
; rasterizer and the frame clock's beat, shows the frame, copies the new triangles into the list and starts it again.
           TIMI   60                            ; a frame every 60 ms: about 17 a second
           LDI    0
           STA    t
frame:     LBA    tris                          ; build this frame's triangles in tris
           TBA
           AMP
           LDI    0
           STA    ntri
           STA    pass                          ; pass 0 draws the bars behind, pass 1 those in front
side:      LDA    t
           STA    ph
           LDI    0
           STA    i
bar:       LBA    cos_table                     ; behind when cos(ph) < 0
           LDA    ph
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           CMPI   0
           JMI    behind
           LDA    pass
           CMPI   1
           JNE    next
           JMP    draw
behind:    LDA    pass
           CMPI   0
           JNE    next
draw:      LBA    sin_table                     ; yc = 240 + sin(ph) * 200 / 256
           LDA    ph
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           MA
           MBI    200
           MUL
           MRD
           ADDI   240
           STA    yc
           SUBI   7
           STA    qy0
           LDA    pass                          ; colours: pass * 6 + i
           CMPI   0
           JEQ    colour
           LDI    6
colour:    TAB
           LDA    i
           ADD
           STA    k
           LBA    bright
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA    cmid
           LBA    shine
           LDA    k
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA    cshine
           LBA    dark
           LDA    k
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA    cedge
           STA    qc0                           ; four bands down the bar: edge, colour, shine, colour, edge
           LDA    yc
           SUBI   3
           STA    qy1
           LDA    cmid
           STA    qc1
           CALL   quad
           LDA    yc
           STA    qy1
           LDA    cshine
           STA    qc1
           CALL   quad
           LDA    yc
           ADDI   3
           STA    qy1
           LDA    cmid
           STA    qc1
           CALL   quad
           LDA    yc
           ADDI   7
           STA    qy1
           LDA    cedge
           STA    qc1
           CALL   quad
           LDA    ntri
           ADDI   8
           STA    ntri
next:      LDA    ph                            ; the next bar, a little further round
           ADDI   4
           ANDI   63
           STA    ph
           LDA    i
           INA
           STA    i
           CMPI   6
           JNE    bar
           LDA    pass
           INA
           STA    pass
           CMPI   2
           JNE    side
wait:      GST                                  ; the last frame is drawn
           CMPI   0
           JNE    wait
beat:      TST                                  ; and its beat has come
           CMPI   0
           JEQ    beat
           TACK
           SWAP                                 ; show it, and start on this one
           CLS
           LDI    0
           ALP
           LBA    tris
           TBA
           AMP
           LDA    ntri
           STA    count
copy:      COPYT
           LDA    count
           SUBI   1
           STA    count
           JNE    copy
           LDI    0
           GADR
           LDA    ntri
           GCNT
           GO
           LDA    t                             ; turn the cylinder a step
           INA
           ANDI   63
           STA    t
           JMP    frame

; quad: two triangles across the screen from row qy0 in colour qc0 to row qy1 in colour qc1, into MEMORY at mp;
; then qy1 and qc1 become qy0 and qc0, for the band below
quad:      LDI    0
           PUTM
           LDA    qy0
           PUTM
           LDI    0
           PUTM
           LDA    qc0
           PUTM
           LDI    640
           PUTM
           LDA    qy0
           PUTM
           LDI    0
           PUTM
           LDA    qc0
           PUTM

programs.description: Big dotted letters on a wave, every dot a blitter square
programs.source:
; Sine scroller
; Big letters scroll right to left on a sine wave, each letter in the next colour round the wheel. Every dot of every
; letter is a 6 by 6 square from the blitter on an 8 pixel grid. The font is 5 by 7 dots, each of a letter's five
; columns one cell whose bits are its dots from the top down. The screen shows 80 columns of dots; each frame the text
; moves 4 pixels, and each column finds its height on the wave in a table worked out at the start. The CPU works out
; the next dot while the blitter fills this one, and BYGO, an instruction made for it, waits for the blitter and
; sends a dot in one go. MEMORY from 3584 holds the table.
           BWI      6                           ; every dot is a 6 by 6 square
           BHI      6
           CALL     waves
           TIMI     33                          ; then a frame every 33 ms: 30 a second
frame:     LDA      k0                          ; start from the column at the left edge
           STA      k
           LDA      j0
           STA      j
           LDA      k0                          ; each letter keeps its colour
           STA      ci
           CALL     glyph
           LDA      frac                        ; x = -frac: the first column is partly off the screen
           TAB
           LDI      0
           SUB
           STA      x
           LDA      wave
           STA      ph
           LDI      81
           STA      cols
col:       LDA      j                           ; the sixth column of a letter is the gap before the next
           CMPI     5
           JEQ      next
           LDA      x                           ; only columns wholly on the screen
           CMPI     633
           JCC      next
           LDA      fp                          ; the dots of this column, a bit each
           TAB
           LDA      j
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           CMPI     0
           JEQ      next
           STA      mask
           LBA      3584                        ; the top of the column on the wave
           LDA      ph
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA      y
cw:        BST                                  ; the blitter is done with the last column: then its column and colour
           CMPI     0
           JNE      cw
           LDA      x
           BX
           LDA      colour
           BC
r0:        LDA      mask                        ; the dots of the column, top down
           ANDI     1
           JEQ      r1
           LDA      y                           ; its row, and the dot once the blitter is done with the last
           BYGO
r1:        LDA      mask
           ANDI     2
           JEQ      r2
           LDA      y
           ADDI     8
           BYGO
r2:        LDA      mask
           ANDI     4
           JEQ      r3
           LDA      y
           ADDI     16
           BYGO
r3:        LDA      mask
           ANDI     8
           JEQ      r4
           LDA      y
           ADDI     24
           BYGO
r4:        LDA      mask
           ANDI     16
           JEQ      r5
           LDA      y
           ADDI     32
           BYGO
r5:        LDA      mask
           ANDI     32
           JEQ      r6
           LDA      y
           ADDI     40
           BYGO
r6:        LDA      mask
           ANDI     64
           JEQ      next
           LDA      y
           ADDI     48
           BYGO
next:      LDA      x                           ; the next column, 8 pixels on and half a step along the wave
           ADDI     8
           STA      x
           LDA      ph
           INA
           ANDI     127
           STA      ph
           LDA      j
           INA
           STA      j
           CMPI     6
           JNE      same
           LDI      0
           STA      j
           LDA      k
           INA
           STA      k
           LDA      ci                          ; each letter in the next colour
           INA
           STA      ci
           CALL     glyph
same:      LDA      cols
           SUBI     1
           STA      cols
           JNE      col
wait:      BST                                  ; the last dot is drawn
           CMPI     0
           JNE      wait
beat:      TST                                  ; and the beat has come
           CMPI     0
           JEQ      beat
           TACK
           SWAP                                 ; show this frame and clear the next
           CLS
           LDA      wave                        ; the wave moves on
           ADDI     2
           ANDI     127
           STA      wave
           LDA      frac                        ; and the text moves 4 pixels left
           ADDI     4
           STA      frac
           CMPI     8
           JCS      frame
           SUBI     8
           STA      frac
           LDA      j0
           INA
           STA      j0
           CMPI     6
           JNE      frame
           LDI      0
           STA      j0
           LDA      k0
           INA
           STA      k0
           LBA      msg                         ; back to the start at the end of the message
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           CMPI     0
           JNE      frame
           LDI      0
           STA      k0
           JMP      frame

; glyph: fp = where the columns of letter k start in font, and colour = its colour; at the end of the message
; k goes back to 0
glyph:     LBA      msg
           LDA      k
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           CMPI     0
           JNE      letter
           LDI      0
           STA      k
           LDA      msg
letter:    SUBI     32                          ; (character - 32) * 5
           TAB
           ADD
           ADD
           ADD
           ADD
           STA      fp
           LBA      font
           LDA      fp
           ADD
           STA      fp
           LBA      rainbow
           LDA      ci
           ANDI     15
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA      colour
           RET

; waves: ytab[ph] = 212 + sin(ph / 2) * 60 / 256 for the 128 half steps round, worked out once

           STA      ph
wavestep:  LBA      sin_table
           LDA      ph
           LSRI     1
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           MA
           MBI      60
           MUL
           MRD
           ADDI     212
           PSA
           LBA      3584
           LDA      ph
           ADD
           TAB
           POA
           STX
           LDA      ph
           INA
           STA      ph
           CMPI     128
           JNE      wavestep
           RET

programs.description: Twenty Gouraud shaded faces tumbling, turned, lit and culled by the CPU every frame
programs.source:
; A shaded icosahedron
; Twenty triangles tumbling about two axes. Every frame the CPU turns the twelve corners with the multiply-accumulate
; unit, gives each corner a shade by how much it faces the viewer, and keeps only the faces that point at the camera,
; found with the cross product. The rasterizer blends each face's three corner colours across it (Gouraud shading),
; and as it is convex no face hides another, so no depth buffer is needed. The CPU works out the next frame while
; the rasterizer draws this one.
           TIMI   40                            ; a frame every 40 ms: 25 a second
           LDI    0
           STA    t
frame:     LDA    t                             ; turning about the vertical axis: angle t
           ANDI   63
           STA    ai
           LBA    cos_table
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA    ca
           LBA    sin_table
           LDA    ai
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA    sa
           TAB
           LDI    0
           SUB
           STA    nsa
           LDA    t                             ; and about the horizontal axis, half as fast
           LSRI   1
           ANDI   63
           STA    ai
           LBA    cos_table
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA    cb
           LBA    sin_table
           LDA    ai
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA    sb
           TAB
           LDI    0
           SUB
           STA    nsb
           CALL   turn
           CALL   build
wait:      GST                                  ; the last frame is drawn
           CMPI   0
           JNE    wait
beat:      TST                                  ; and its beat has come
           CMPI   0
           JEQ    beat
           TACK
           SWAP                                 ; show it, and start on this one
           CLS
           LDI    0
           ALP
           LBA    tris
           TBA
           AMP
           LDA    ntri
           CMPI   0
           JEQ    next
           STA    count
copy:      COPYT
           LDA    count
           SUBI   1
           STA    count
           JNE    copy
           LDI    0
           GADR
           LDA    ntri
           GCNT
           GO
next:      LDA    t
           INA
           STA    t
           JMP    frame

; turn: every corner (x, y, z) in verts becomes (screen x, screen y, shade 0 to 15) in proj
turn:
           LBA    verts
           TBA
           STA    p
           LBA    proj
           TBA
           AMP
           LDI    12
           STA    count
corner:    LDA    p
           TAB
           LDX
           STA    vx
           INB
           LDX
           STA    vy
           INB
           LDX
           STA    vz
           INB
           TBA
           STA    p
           LDA    vx                            ; x1 = x cos a + z sin a
           MA
           LDA    ca
           MB
           MUL
           LDA    vz
           MA
           LDA    sa
           MB
           MAC
           MRD
           ADDI   320                           ; screen x
           PUTM
           LDA    vz                            ; z1 = z cos a - x sin a
           MA
           LDA    ca
           MB
           MUL
           LDA    vx
           MA
           LDA    nsa
           MB
           MAC
           MRD
           STA    z1
           LDA    vy                            ; y2 = y cos b - z1 sin b
           MA
           LDA    cb
           MB
           MUL
           LDA    z1
           MA
           LDA    nsb
           MB
           MAC
           MRD
           ADDI   240                           ; screen y
           PUTM
           LDA    vy                            ; z2 = y sin b + z1 cos b
           MA
           LDA    sb
           MB
           MUL
           LDA    z1
           MA
           LDA    cb
           MB
           MAC
           MRD
           ADDI   112                           ; shade = (z2 + 112) * 18 / 256, 0 on the far side to 15 on the near
           MA
           MBI    18
           MUL
           MRD
           PUTM
           LDA    count
           SUBI   1
           STA    count
           JNE    corner
           RET

; build: the faces that point at the camera, as triangles in tris; ntri says how many
build:     LBA    tris
           TBA
           AMP
           LBA    faces
           TBA
           STA    f
           LDI    0
           STA    ntri
           LDI    20
           STA    count
face:      LDA    f                             ; its three corners and its colour ramp
           TAB
           LDX
           STA    o0
           INB
           LDX
           STA    o1
           INB
           LDX
           STA    o2
           INB
           LDX
           STA    ramp
           INB
           TBA
           STA    f
           LBA    proj                          ; where the corners are on the screen
           LDA    o0
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA    x0
           INB
           LDX
           STA    y0
           LBA    proj
           LDA    o1
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA    x1
           INB
           LDX
           STA    y1
           LBA    proj
           LDA    o2
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           STA    x2
           INB
           LDX
           STA    y2
           LDA    x0                            ; (x1 - x0)(y2 - y0) - (y1 - y0)(x2 - x0): above 0 when it faces us
           TAB
           LDA    x1
           SUB
           XA
           LDA    y0
           TAB
           LDA    y2
           SUB
           XB
           XMUL
           LDA    y1
           TAB
           LDA    y0
           SUB
           XA
           LDA    x0
           TAB
           LDA    x2
           SUB
           XB
           XMAC
           XRD
           CMPI   0
           JEQ    fnext
           JMI    fnext
           LDA    o0                            ; three corners: x, y, depth 0 and the colour for its shade
           CALL   emit
           LDA    o1
           CALL   emit
           LDA    o2
           CALL   emit
           LDA    ntri
           INA
           STA    ntri
fnext:     LDA    count
           SUBI   1
           STA    count
           JNE    face
           RET

; emit: the corner at offset A in proj as x, y, 0 and ramp[shade], at mp
emit:      TAB
           LBA    proj
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           PUTM
           INB
           LDX
           PUTM
           INB
           LDI    0
           PUTM
           LDX
           TAB
           LDA    ramp
           ADD
           TAB
           LDX
           PUTM
           RET
